about.label: Background
about.title: ABOUT
about.bio1: A fullstack engineer building financial back-office systems, working AI-first since 2025. I specify and review; agents implement, test, and refactor. Every line is reviewed, and nothing ships that I can't explain.
about.bio2: The method changed what one person can carry. In 2025 I built the foundation of a currency exchange back office alone, taking its bookkeeping module from the first shareholder conversation to production in about two months. When two developers joined, I moved the team onto one shared workflow: repo-level agent rules, shared skills and agents, spec-driven tickets, a single review checklist for agent-written code.
about.approachBody: Systems thinking over feature stacking. Architecture, service contracts, and specs are mine; implementation is delegated and verified. The result is a codebase any member of the team can maintain, because the documentation and the tickets are written the same way every time.
